status: pre-registered before the first calibration run; the planted-signal gates are PROPOSED and carried into the run under the Maintainer's 2026-10-13 instruction, with confirmation pending

permutation_p_null.rule: binomial P(K >= k | rate 0.05) >= 0.01 and chi-square goodness-of-fit P over the B + 1 values >= 0.01

leaky_reference.scenario: leaky selection on all data (fixed panel chosen on all units), each family

loocv_null.rule: |mean - 0.5| <= 0.03 and mean + 1.96 SE <= 0.53 on the pooled out-of-fold AUC

blocked_null.scenario: null, subject-blocked units (ridge, lasso, elastic net)
blocked_null.rule: |mean - 0.5| <= 0.03 and mean + 1.96 SE <= 0.53 (blocked nested AUC); blocked permutation P rules as permutation_p_null
blocked_null.source: R14f blocked rules, carried over unchanged

blocked_ungrouped_reference.rule: mean ungrouped AUC - mean grouped AUC > 0.05

planted_signal_auc.scenario: planted signal (five features shifted by 1.5 SD in the positive class), each family

planted_signal_p.rule: permutation P <= 0.05 in at least 90 percent of replicates

design.units: 15 vs 15 biological units (null and planted), 200 pure-noise features; planted: five features +1.5 SD in the positive class
design.outer: 2 x 5-fold repeated stratified (LOOCV: leave-one-unit-out with 12 vs 12 units)
design.inner: 3-fold, tuning on the inner out-of-fold AUC
design.selection: top-5 by AUC on the training fold (the R14d top_k_auc rule)
design.blocked: 10 vs 10 subjects x 2 observations; whole-subject permutations; ungrouped reference with observation-level folds

families.kind: ridge logistic (glmnet alpha 0; lambda grid tuned by inner CV)
lasso logistic (glmnet alpha 1; lambda grid tuned by inner CV)
elastic net logistic (glmnet alpha 0.5, declared; lambda grid tuned by inner CV)
linear SVM (e1071, cost grid {0.1, 1, 10} tuned by inner CV on AUC)
polynomial SVM (e1071, cost grid {0.1, 1, 10} tuned by inner CV on AUC)
random forest (randomForest, 500 trees; optional package, NOT_RUN when absent)

seeds.family_offset: +1000 x family index (penalized_logistic 0 ... random_forest 5); the null bases equal the R14f seeds for penalized_logistic
